description: Immutable money ledger — one INSERT-only row per money event (deposits, reserves, loan funding, repayments, fees, withdrawals). Balances are projections over this ledger, replacing the mutable clientWallets totals as source of truth. Corrections are new REVERSAL entries, never updates. See docs/payment-banking-first-redesign.md (Phase 1) and the capability-model spec.

fields.name: clientId
fields.description: Wallet owner. NULL means the platform's own ledger (commissions, float).

fields.name: entryType
fields.description: Money event type. Allowed values: DEPOSIT, RESERVE, RELEASE, LOAN_FUNDING, DISBURSEMENT_RECEIVED, REPAYMENT_PRINCIPAL, REPAYMENT_INTEREST, PLATFORM_FEE, WITHDRAWAL, REFUND, REVERSAL, ADJUSTMENT, CAPITAL_DECLARED, CAPITAL_COMMITTED, CAPITAL_UNDECLARED. Lookup values live in database hints, not a separate field table. CAPITAL_* describe a lender's declared-capital STATE (see RFC-002/RFC-003) — they are NEVER real money and must never be interpreted as SmartLoans holding, receiving, or moving funds; they coexist with the real-money types above, they do not replace DEPOSIT/WITHDRAWAL (the simulated/real SPEI-in-testing path still uses DEPOSIT).

fields.name: direction
fields.description: D = debit (balance down), C = credit (balance up), from the wallet owner's perspective.

fields.name: amountMXN
fields.description: Always positive; direction carries the sign. Stored as decimal(12,2).

fields.name: referenceType
fields.description: What produced this entry. Allowed values: transfer, collection, loan, stripe_tx, manual.

fields.name: referenceId
fields.description: Id in the referenced table (transfers.transferId, loans.loanId, ...). With referenceType forms the audit link.

fields.name: idempotencyKey
fields.description: UNIQUE per company. The orchestrator's dedupe guarantee: replays never double-post a money event.

fields.name: balanceAfter
fields.description: Denormalized running available balance after applying this entry — makes statements and reconciliation O(1). Stored as decimal(12,2).

fields.name: note
fields.description: Short human-readable memo shown in the client's movement history.

relationships.notes: Multi-tenant isolation via companyId — injected automatically by stored procedures.
clientId references clients; NULL rows are the platform ledger.

components.name: WalletMovementListStep
components.description: IonList of ledger entries newest-first, filtered by companyId + clientId, optional entryType. Rows show entryType chip, signed amount (D red / C green), note, created_At, running balanceAfter.

hints: INSERT-only ledger: the CRUD SP must implement action 1 (insert) and reads; action 2 (update) and action 3 (delete) must return an error — corrections are REVERSAL inserts.
Indexes: (clientId, created_At DESC) for statements; (referenceType, referenceId) for reconciliation.
